_meta.status: PR0 interface proposal. Migration keys under _provisional_copy are one coherent takeover alternative, awaiting owner D10; they are not shipping authorization. Original handoff remains unchanged in its source file.
_meta.source: docs/plans/2026-09-21-setup-three-screen-handoff.md §4/§5/§8, reconciled against the strings already shipped on master 31c4e831b.
rules: PR0 adds no key to ui/src/i18n/*.json. Each lane lands the keys it owns together with the component that references them, because keyCoverage.test.ts reads the literal keys out of the app source.

Every string that interpolates {{count}} ships a complete _one/_other family in BOTH bundles; zh repeats the same value so locale parity stays a plain set equality. This is the rule settings.models already enforces by test (copyAgreement.test.ts) and the class it exists to prevent.
{{names}} is a joined list, so it may never be the subject of a singular verb in English.

Orchestrator D8 allocates setup vocabulary separately from Settings. D10 must adopt setup takeover behavior before _provisional_copy ships; no copy-only or unchanged-native-state claims may accompany migration_apply.
No string in this contract is a credential example. The prototype's sk-demo-example placeholder and its 交互演示，请勿输入真实凭据 / 正在保存模拟配置… lines are preview-only and must not ship (handoff §15).

Model-ranked route rows use exact source/upstream-model pairs. C6 specifies displayed Agent/menu-model targets, backend subsets, divergent hydration and per-target readback. Shared does not mean every model is eligible for every assistant.

_provisional_copy.decision: D10: recommended complete-group takeover; owner choice still required before setup migration ships. The literal copy alternative also needs native coexistence/Hub admission design.
behavior: Cards, Detected tab and primary action open one complete-group review; selection or runtime start never applies credentials. Only Start migration confirms; Not now keeps native authentication and mode unchanged.
Show exact approved consequence sentence from model-hub-native-takeover.md. Preserve unrelated settings; apply owns credential cleanup and Hub mode/placement together.
Setup remains API-key-only: show but block whole groups containing OAuth or non-importable rows. Counts are migration items, not inferred keys or Sources.
Unknown or failed apply requires readback/recovery before retry; no blanket atomic rollback, copy-only or unchanged-assistant-connections promise.
